title: Unit Event — Whither This Path of Thorns — Episode2 Watchers

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu's big step forward in her own life inspires another member of N25. Before the School Festival, Mizuki resolves to open up to Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna see what I can do about dealing with my own problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It seems that time has finally come...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a question about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Something didn't seem quite right.
You need to tell me if you have any information.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm surprised to hear you asking about Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mizuki's words have the power to help Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mafuyu needs to hear them in order to move forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't actually have any details...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, as I told you when you first arrived, we're dealing with some very complicated feelings here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And it seems that Mizuki is currently setting the stage to face those feelings head-on...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I sensed quite a bit of doubt just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What exactly is Mizuki afraid of or running from?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not in a position to say...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you going over to see Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mizuki is trying to cross a thin sheet of ice right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What you're planning on saying is going to be too strong. So strong that you might make that ice crack...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, you want me to do nothing...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If doing nothing will solve everything, then that's fine by me. But do you honestly believe that's going to bring about real change?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't think that your solution is always the best one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I made the decision to finally tell her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's up?
You hardly ever come to see me like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You have no right asking such a question!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You really feel the need to intervene like this...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Fine.
But let me at least say this.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Mizuki.
You're stuck at a crossroads, yes?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I have no way of knowing what's eating away at you...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You find yourself at a crossroads because you're trying to make a choice... Because you want to make a choice, not because of anyone else.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I don't care if you decide to run or move forward...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But just know this... In the midst of this pain, you need to choose the path that allows you to save yourself.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I've witnessed the pain you bear.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I honestly believe that you shouldn't try to do anything...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Because what you're carrying...is so incredibly fragile.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'll see this through with you.
No matter how things turn out.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Regardless of how the future unfolds, I'll be there with you until the end.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I... I just need a little bit more time...
